# youtrack_custom_field (Data Source)

Looks up an existing custom field prototype by name, for example the built-in `Priority` or `State`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "youtrack_custom_field" "priority" {
  name = "Priority"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the custom field.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Database ID of the custom field.
- `type` (String) Field type, for example `enum[1]`.
